import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:js_interop';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:luxo_client/luxo_client.dart';
import '__WEBSOCKET_ID_CASES__';

@JS('process.argv')
external JSArray<JSString> get arguments;

Future<void> main() async {
  final endpoint = arguments.toDart.last.toDart;
  await verifyWebSocketIDs(endpoint);
  await verifySocketAdapterFault(endpoint);
  for (final mode in TransportMode.values) {
    for (final parse in [false, true]) await verifySocketFailure(endpoint, mode, parse);
  }
  print('web socket protocol verified');
}

Future<void> verifySocketFailure(String endpoint, TransportMode mode, bool parse) async {
    final expected = parse ? 'ParseError' : 'NetworkError';
    final transport = WsTransport(endpoint,
      options: TransportOptions(mode: mode), autoReconnect: false,
      timeout: const Duration(seconds: 3));
    transport.setSchema({
      'echo': const APISchemaEntry(7, [ParamSchema(1, 'value', 'Int')]),
      'disconnect': const APISchemaEntry(8),
      'malformed': const APISchemaEntry(9),
    });
    LuxoInt64 decode(Object? data) => data is Uint8List
        ? LuxoDecoder(data).readIntChecked() : luxoInt64FromJSON(data);
    final value = LuxoInt64.maxValue;
    try {
      final result = await transport.call('echo', params: {'value': value}, decoder: decode);
      if (result != value) throw StateError('$mode call lost integer precision');
      final received = [Completer<LuxoInt64>(), Completer<LuxoInt64>()];
      final ended = [Completer<LuxoError>(), Completer<LuxoError>()];
      var deliveries = 0;
      var errors = 0;
      final stops = await Future.wait([
        for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++)
          transport.subscribe('echo', {'value': value}, (data) {
            deliveries++;
            received[i].complete(decode(data));
          }, onError: (error) {
            errors++;
            ended[i].complete(error);
          }, onDone: () => throw StateError('disconnect completed normally'), decoder: (value) => value),
      ]);
      if ((await Future.wait(received.map((entry) => entry.future)))
          .any((result) => result != value)) {
        throw StateError('$mode stream lost integer precision');
      }
      try {
        await transport.call(parse ? 'malformed' : 'disconnect', decoder: decode);
        throw StateError('disconnected call unexpectedly succeeded');
      } on LuxoError catch (error) {
        if (error.error != expected) throw StateError('$expected became ${error.error}');
      }
      final failures = await Future.wait(ended.map((entry) => entry.future))
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 3));
      if (failures.any((error) => error.error != expected)) {
        throw StateError('disconnected subscription did not report $expected');
      }
      if (await transport.call('echo', params: {'value': value}, decoder: decode) != value) {
        throw StateError('reconnected call failed');
      }
      final next = Completer<LuxoInt64>();
      final stop = await transport.subscribe('echo', {'value': value},
        (data) => next.complete(decode(data)),
        onError: (_) => throw StateError('new subscription failed'), decoder: (value) => value);
      for (final oldStop in stops) oldStop();
      if (await next.future != value || deliveries != 2 || errors != 2) {
        throw StateError('old subscription was replayed or affected the new one');
      }
      stop();
    } finally {
      transport.close();
    }
}

Future<void> verifySocketAdapterFault(String endpoint) async {
  final transport = WsTransport('$endpoint/adapter-fault', autoReconnect: false,
    timeout: const Duration(seconds: 3));
  try {
    for (final subscription in [false, true]) {
      try {
        if (subscription) {
          await transport.subscribe('echo', {}, (_) => throw StateError('unexpected data'), decoder: (value) => value);
        } else {
          await transport.call<Object>('echo');
        }
        throw StateError('invalid socket event was accepted');
      } on LuxoError catch (error) {
        if (error.error != 'NetworkError') rethrow;
      }
    }
  } finally {
    transport.close();
  }
}
